data: Which of the lines represents the model trained with 75% of the training data?

The green line represents the model trained with 75% of the training data. This can be determined by the caption which states that the series represent training the model with the entire training set, or randomly subsampled proportions of training data summing to 75%, 50%, and 25% of the original training set size. The green line corresponds to the 75% label in the legend.
